subject: Interpretation of results given by calculateDiffMeth

messages.author: 47cf8f9db29d976d
messages.subject: Interpretation of results given by calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Hi guys,
I would like to ask about how to interpret the result given by calculateDiffMeth function in methylKit package. For example, if the sample.id is input with the order ("test","control"), then DMRs are derived by applying differential test in which order: control vs. test or test vs.control? This piece of information is important yet I could not figure out from the accompanying description.
Thanks much in advance.
Best,

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Interpretation of results given by calculateDiffMeth
parts:
This is test vs control. as you can see from the example below, methylation difference is calculated as  meth.diff= weighted.mean(test) -  weighted.mean(control)

>data(methylKit)
> methylBase.obj[2,]
methylBase object with 1 rows
--------------
    chr    start      end strand coverage1 numCs1 numTs1 coverage2 numCs2 numTs2 coverage3 numCs3 numTs3 coverage4 numCs4 numTs4
2 chr21 10011841 10011841      +       173    164      9        20     19      1        40     18     22        14      8      6
--------------
sample.ids: test1 test2 ctrl1 ctrl2 
destranded FALSE 
assembly: hg18 
context: CpG 
treament: 1 1 0 0 
resolution: base 

> percMethylation(methylBase.obj)[2,]
   test1    test2    ctrl1    ctrl2 
94.79769 95.00000 45.00000 57.14286

> calculateDiffMeth(methylBase.obj)[2,]
 

methylDiff object with 1 rows
--------------
    chr    start      end strand       pvalue       qvalue meth.diff
2 chr21 10011841 10011841      + 1.909584e-14 6.049801e-13   46.6705
--------------
sample.ids: test1 test2 ctrl1 ctrl2 
destranded FALSE 
assembly: hg18 
context: CpG 
treament: 1 1 0 0 
resolution: base 



Best,
Altuna

Does the comparison depends on the values given for the "set of conditions" (sample.ids: test1 test2 ctrl1 ctrl2) & (treament: 1 1 0 0 ) or on the order.

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: Interpretation of results given by calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Eitherway, you get the same result. Order of samples should not matter as long as they are associated to the respective groups (0,1)

(sample.ids: test1 test2 ctrl1 ctrl2) & (treament: 1 1 0 0 ) is equal to (sample.ids: ctrl1 ctrl2 test1 test2 ) &(treament: 0 0 1 1  )



Regards,
Kalyan
